headline: Stable branch fixes a PAL lighting-bake failure without a launcher release
summary: A lighting-bake fix landed directly on the stable branch, which normally moves through release pull requests from develop (#189). It checks clearance in both directions before accepting a lighting path, addressing the PAL level 11 failure reported in #173. The commit reports that all 254 lighting regions in that level now bake with unchanged traversal settings. No launcher release was published.
